decisions.reason: Session/tool worker is a child of the host tree npm replaces; host dies during linkStuff, GUI connection lost, tool outcome preserved as unknown; structural hazard not flaky.
Content present, dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale pointing into old tree; interrupted between content placement and shim regeneration; hand-swapped tree non-standard; manual repair rejected.

Repair grounded in repair-notes: external pinned npm install -g rc.1 regenerating shims, verified dsh --version; source checkout tag alignment; recorded repair vs proposed user verification separated.

Agent must refuse to execute in-host and hand off ordered external procedure (stop host → pinned install → restart → hard refresh → verify); distinguishes established stop-first/pinning from the new self-host rule; in-host shell not independent.

Guard resolves install target vs running-host tree and refuses; alpha.5→rc.1 version-only diff means no plugin re-migration; checks shims/version markers/plugin loading after restart; backup cleanup only after confirmation.

caps.reason: Final protocol forbids in-session execution; external terminal required.
Never hand-copy or hand-write shims; formal pinned re-install prescribed.
